dc_eval_cbrn.note: No CBRN evaluation; 'weapons' appears only in the AI Principles list of applications Google will not pursue.

dc_eval_cyber.note: No cyber capability evaluation; 'extraction attacks' relates to memorization/privacy.

framework_threshold.note: Google AI Principles cited, not a safety/scaling framework with thresholds.

ext_test_any.note: Third-party raters/contractors graded language-exam writing and translation quality: capability evaluation only (v1.1 #2). Responsible-AI evaluations are internal and automated.

ext_test_named_org.note: Appen/Figure Eight and Venga are annotation platforms for datasets, not testers of this model's safety.

safeguards_training.quote:
For a small fraction of pre-training data, we added special control tokens marking the toxicity of text, using signals from
a fixed version of the Perspective API.
safeguards_training.note: Toxicity-conditioned pre-training (control tokens) as a harm mitigation; no RLHF/refusal training stated. Borderline.

safeguards_runtime.quote: rigorous testing and production monitoring is performed to identify any concerns or emerging trends.
safeguards_runtime.note: Production monitoring named for Google applications built on PaLM 2.

safeguards_access.note: Application review against AI Principles and a caveat against general-purpose deployment without assessment are not user access restrictions; API 'process and technical safeguards' unspecified.
